themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers and researchers in writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses various AI applications and platforms designed to accelerate or enhance research processes.

themes.description: Examines the performance, reliability, and user interaction aspects of AI chatbots in research contexts.
